headline: Olave Garden Serves a Five-Course Ass-Whooping While Bo Nix Celli Forgets to Show Up
subhead: Week 9 was a bloodbath — six wins by 28+ points, zero competitive games, and one team that scored less than a JV soccer match.
matchOfTheWeek: The Olave Garden didn't just beat Hot Cocks, he hung 187.14 on him with a starting lineup that read like a Sunday Night Football promo — Burrow (30.14), Achane (32.10), Zay Flowers (29.70), Kelce (29.00), AND Kamara (27.50). Hot Cocks ran his lineup at 98% efficiency and STILL got steamrolled by 62. When you're optimal and still losing by a touchdown per quarter, that's not a loss — that's a public service announcement.
powerRankingsShakeup: The Olave Garden and 226 Alpha both dropped 170+ and look like the actual class of the league, while Bo Nix Celli is plummeting toward the basement after a 89.50 that genuinely should be investigated by league officials.
mainRecap:
Let's start with Bo Nix Celli, who put up 89.50 points in a SuperFlex league. Eighty. Nine. Point. Five. That's not a fantasy score, that's a credit score in 2009. Justin Herbert dropped 19.48 on your bench while you trotted out lineup decisions that would get a 12-year-old kicked out of his first Yahoo league. Then you traded picks for nothing while Hot Cocks robbed you blind of Brian Robinson. Cool week, champ.

The Good Ladds deserve their own circle of hell. You scored 112.46 and left 44.38 on the bench — including Demarcus Robinson going for 27.4 in the same week your starters were collectively getting waterboarded by 226 Alpha's 174.92. Szara didn't even need Hurts' 29.90 to win, he could've started his backup kicker and still cleared you.

LargestofRocks won by 58, which sounds great until you realize DeAndre Hopkins (28.6), Daniel Jones (24.36), and Quentin Johnston (22.0) combined for 75 points ON THE BENCH. You beat OnlyFants while leaving an entire second starting lineup in the garage. OnlyFants got 30 from Garrett Wilson and still lost by 60 — congrats Cubby, your WR1 is a one-man band and the rest of your roster is tambourines.

Stroud Boys squeaked by Put an AR to My Head in the "closest" game of the week, which was still a 28-point margin because Jaxon Smith-Njigba decided to drop a 37-burger. Kyle got 32.9 from Saquon and still couldn't crack 100 — you're starting to look like a guy who drafted one good player and called it a roster.

MassiveCocks beat Jets' Juniors behind Mike Gesicki of all people putting up 29.5 at TE. Mattwunder, when Gesicki is the league-winner, the simulation has officially broken.

T Swift's Baddies cruised past the Bo Nix corpse without breaking a sweat. Don't get cocky Tnicolle — you beat a team that scored less than most kickers' fantasy points combined this season.
